blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.

blocks.en:
Every frontier LLM is now,
in part,
a student of its predecessors and competitors.
Model developers describe pipelines in which one model authors coding challenges,
math problems or reasoning environments,
and the next model trains on them ( Xu et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2025a ; Cai et al., 2025 ) .
The same synthetic data spreads through public repositories and benchmarks,
where other labs’ training runs ingest it ( Drayson et al., 2025 ) .
Models thus co-evolve:
each one’s training distribution is shaped by what other models chose to write.
When a lab closes this loop deliberately,
having its own models write the curriculum for the next generation,
the process becomes recursive self-improvement in a concrete engineering sense.
Either way,
what a model learns depends on how well another model can write problems worth learning from ( Xu et al., 2025b ) .

A model’s skill as an author therefore shapes what the next generation learns,
in its own family or a competitor’s.
Language models now match or exceed human performance on many established benchmarks ( Center for AI Safety et al., 2026 ) .
As they do,
sufficiently challenging human-authored tasks become increasingly costly to curate ( Henniger and Poesia, 2026 ) ,
and recent progress on long-standing open problems,
including Millennium Prize conjectures ( OpenAI, 2026a ) ,
suggests that even the supply of unsolved challenges a model can train on is finite.
Once the stock of existing problems thins out,
the bottleneck moves: what matters is the ability to pose new problems that are worth solving.
A model that can formulate well-specified,
novel challenges,
and calibrate their difficulty to push the boundaries of current methods,
is the kind of capability that could drive fully autonomous scientific research.

blocks.en:
Environment Duels builds a microcosm of this ecosystem.
Every model plays two roles:
it writes executable environments for the others to solve,
and it solves the environments they write.
An environment is an interactive program with hidden state,
a reward and an action budget,
a richer format than a static text question:
solvers must explore,
act and adapt over many turns rather than answer once.
Each author also supplies a privileged hint that lets a solver approach its environment correctly,
and aims for an environment that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it.
After the first round,
each author sees how the others actually played and answers with one counter-move.
We run this duel among nine frontier models,
90 environments and 12,960 episodes in all,
and score each model on how well it solves ( solve rate ),
how hard its environments are ( difficulty ),
and how much its hints help ( hint lift ).

blocks.en:
In Environment Duels,
every evaluated model is both an author and a solver.
A designer writes an executable environment together with a privileged hint; every other model then plays it twice on identical instances,
once with the hint in its context and once without.
Measured outcomes then return to the designer,
which answers with one counter-move,
a revised environment shaped by how the other models played.

We describe construction (Section 2.1 ),
then the duel and its scores (Section 2.2 ).

This keeps the design effort separate from implementation effort,
so that the environments are harder and better calibrated.

blocks.en:
The counter-move is one round of co-evolution:
authors adapt to the solvers they face,
and a single round raises both difficulty and hint lift,
with the no-hint pass rate falling from 84.9% to 78.5%
and hint lift rising from 6.3% to 13.4%.
Authors can thus take feedback from other models and turn it into harder,
better-calibrated environments.
Such loops are increasingly common outside the duel.
A user who consults an LLM council sends one question to several models,
which review and rank one another’s answers before one of them writes the final response ( Karpathy, 2025 ) ;
related systems let models debate or build on each other’s outputs ( Du et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ) .
The counter-move isolates one such loop under controlled conditions;
Section 3.2 and Appendix E analyse its effect further.

The hardest environments and the most useful hints come from smaller models trained with recent recipes,
not from the strongest solvers.

As solvers,
the nine models rank much as public capability indices rank them: Claude-Opus-5 and GPT-5.6-Sol lead here,
as they do on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) (Figure 2 ).
On this axis the duel confirms what existing benchmarks measure.
It differs from them in how it ages.
A fixed test set saturates once models master it,
whereas the environments of a duel are written by the models under evaluation,
so its ceiling is set by the strongest author rather than fixed in advance.
Keeping the benchmark at the frontier therefore requires no new annotation:
adding a stronger model adds harder environments,
at the cost of tokens alone.

作为解决者
9种模式在公共能力指数中排行榜: Claude -Opus -5和GPT -5.6 -Sol在这里领先,
正如它们在人工分析智能指数(人工分析,2026年)(图2.)上所做的那样。
在这一轴线上,决斗确认了现有基准衡量标准。
它与它们不同的是 它的老化。
一个固定的测试组饱和 一旦模型掌握它,
而决斗的环境是由被评价的模型书写的,
所以它的上限是由最强的作者设定的,而不是事先固定的.
因此,在边界保持基准不需要新的说明:
增加一个更强大的模型 增加更难的环境,
仅以象征性物品为代价。

blocks.en:
The two authoring axes are the ones an author controls:
Difficulty measures how hard its environments are without help,
and hint lift how much its hints help.
On both,
the top three places go to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash , Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-27B (on hint lift DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash shares third place with Inkling-Small ),
three compact models that rank third,
seventh and fourth as solvers. Claude-Opus-5 and GPT-5.6-Sol ,
the two strongest solvers,
rank no higher than fourth on Difficulty and seventh on hint lift.
The same three models write nine of the ten environments that Claude-Opus-5 fails at least once.

很难衡量环境有多困难,
并提示它有多有帮助。

blocks.en:
Authoring is thus a skill distinct from solving,
and a smaller model can exceed a frontier model at it.
One plausible cause is post-training,
as reported for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash :
its developers attribute its post-training gains to automated pipelines in which agents synthesize tasks,
construct environments and calibrate their difficulty ( Xu et al., 2026a ) .
A model that improves through self-constructed environments is,
in effect,
trained on the task that environment duels measure,
and its lead as an author suggests that the duel measures precisely this capacity for creating useful training data.
Environment authoring skill may therefore depend more on training than on scale.

因此,写作是一种不同于解决问题的技能,

因此,环境授权技能可能更多地取决于培训而不是规模。

Writing a useful hint is unrelated to solving well (Figure 3 , left). Qwen3.8-27B ,

These breaks are mismatches rather than errors.
Top-tier hints turn 17.7% of the bottom tier’s correct attempts wrong,
against at most 7.7% for other hints,
yet no tier’s hints break more than 3.1% of the top tier’s (Figure 3 , right).
Weaker authors name the trap and the move
(“the ramp … is the trap”),
while the strongest state the mechanism and leave the derivation to the solver
(“tones are affine in the values you seat”).
Weaker solvers given such a hint commit early and fail after a median of 13 actions,
where without it they had succeeded by slow exploration in 20.
Section 4 shows that this learner-specific hint lift also tracks which authors’ environments train a model best.

blocks.en:
The counter-move makes most environments harder (Figure 4 ),
but the two strongest solvers adapt least. GPT-5.6-Sol leaves its environments essentially unchanged,
and Claude-Opus-5 changes less than the average author in both pass rate and hint lift,
while Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3 lower their pass rates by 13.1 and 10.8 points.
One reading is that strong models trust their original design and take feedback less readily.
Another is that their feedback is weaker:
the trajectories an author sees come from the other solvers,
and for the strongest authors nearly all of them are weaker,
so they expose fewer shortcuts worth closing.
blocks.zh:
反运动使大多数环境更加困难(图4),
但两个最强的解答者 适应最少。 GPT-5.6-醇使其环境基本保持不变,
Claude-Opus-5在通过率和提示升降率上的变化都低于一般作者,
而Qune3.8-27B和GLM-5.3的通过率则降低了13.1分和10.8分.
一种读取方式是强力模型相信其原始设计,并不太容易获得反馈.
另一个是它们的反馈较弱:
作者看到的轨迹来自其他解决者,
对于最强的作者来说,他们几乎都是软弱的,
因此,它们暴露了更少的捷径 值得关闭。

blocks.en: 3.3 Inside Environment Duels
blocks.zh: 3.3 环境内部决斗

blocks.en:
The aggregate scores summarise the duel,
but each entry of the matrix,
one author’s environments met by one solver,
records a specific interaction.
Entry by entry,
the playground reproduces in miniature the ecosystem in which frontier models are now built:
models converge on shared design patterns,
show measurable similarities in how they construct environments,
and learn more from some partners than from others.
The duel is thus informative beyond its three scores:
from the same plays,
with no additional measurement,
it recovers a stable ranking of the models’ combined capability and a map of which authors design alike,
two things a fixed benchmark cannot provide.
blocks.zh:
总分总结了决斗
但每个输入的矩阵,
一位作者的环境与一位解答者相遇,
记录特定的交互。
逐个输入,
该游乐场以小型形式繁殖了目前建立前沿模型的生态系统:
模型趋同于共享设计模式,
显示它们如何构建环境的可衡量相似性,
从一些伙伴那里学到的比其他伙伴多。
因此,决斗的内容超出了其三个分数:
从相同的戏剧,
没有额外的测量,
它恢复了模型综合能力的稳定排名和作者同样设计的地图,
固定基准不能提供两点。

blocks.en:
For two models,
we compare the first model’s pass rate on the second’s environments with the second’s pass rate on the first’s (Figure 5 a),
so the margin credits both solving the opponent’s environments and writing environments the opponent cannot solve.
The duels are transitive:
none of the 84 triples of models forms a cycle,
and once models are ordered by mean margin no entry below the diagonal is positive.
This ranking is not the solving ranking. Claude-Opus-5 wins all eight of its duels,
but DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is second,
solving 92% of GPT-5.6-Sol ’s environments against 75% the other way,
and Qwen3.8-27B ,
fourth as a solver,
is third.
Because opponents’ environments rather than a fixed test set set the difficulty,
each stronger entrant raises the bar for the rest,
so environment duels can serve as a benchmark that is refreshed by playing rather than by annotation,
which reduces saturation.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Synthetic training methods differ in whether they generate examples, executable environments, or adaptive tasks. Instruction-data generation ( Xu et al., 2025a ) supplies samples, whereas executable-environment methods ( Faldor et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Jeong and Yoon, 2026 ) create settings in which agents act under generated rules and rewards. Feedback can refine search-agent questions ( Xu et al., 2026b ) , adapt tasks or environments to learning signals ( Zeng et al., 2026b ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) , or supply terminal-oriented practice ( Gandhi et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . SPADE trains a designer on aggregate hinted–unhinted returns ( Liu et al., 2026 ) ; EnvHarness revises environments from policy trajectories while preserving verifiers ( Huang et al., 2026a ) , and verifier hardening repairs checkers ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . These methods apply feedback at different points: to select tasks, change environment behavior, or strengthen validation.
blocks.zh: 合成培训方法在产生实例、可执行环境或适应性任务方面各不相同。 指令数据生成(徐等,2025年a)提供样本,而可执行环境方法(Faldor等,2025年;Cai等,2025年;Wang等,2026年b;Jeong和Yoon,2026年)则创造了代理人根据产生的规则和奖励行事的环境。 反馈可完善搜索代理问题(徐等,2026b),使任务或环境适应学习信号(曾等,2026b; Guo等,2025;Wu等,2026;Fan等,2026;或供应终端导向做法(Gandhi等,2026;Fu等,2026;Zhu等,2026;). EnvHarness从政策轨迹中修改环境,同时保留核查器(Huang等,2026a),以及核查器硬化修理检查器(Zhong等,2026)。 这些方法在不同点应用反馈:选择任务,改变环境行为,或加强验证.

blocks.en: Recursive self-improvement connects feedback about agent behavior to changes in future challenges or in the agent itself. PAIRED uses protagonist–antagonist regret ( Dennis et al., 2020 ) , while Enhanced POET co-evolves challenges and solvers ( Wang et al., 2020 ) . Language-model systems generate and solve tasks or co-train challengers and solvers ( Zhao et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026a ) ; Self-Evolving Curriculum selects RL problem categories, whereas SOAR rewards a teacher according to student progress ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Sundaram et al., 2026 ) . STOP and the Darwin Gödel Machine instead recursively revise agent implementations ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . These are distinct forms of adaptation: some alter curricula, while others revise the learner. Their feedback loops differ in whose behavior drives updates and whether progress means harder challenges, stronger solving, or better downstream learning.
blocks.zh: 递归自修将关于代理人行为的反馈与未来挑战或代理人本身的变化联系起来. PAIRED使用主角-antagonist regret (Dennis等, 2020年),而增强POET则共同演化出挑战和解决者(Wang等, 2020年). 语言模型系统生成并解决任务或共同培训挑战者和解决者(赵等,2025a; Huang等人, 2026b; Zhou等人, 2025; Xia等人, 2026a;自我演变课程选择RL问题类别,而SOAR则根据学生的进步给予教师奖励(Chen等人, 2026; Sundaram等人, 2026). Stop and Darwin Gödel Machine 转而修改剂执行(Zelikman等,2024;Zhang等,2026a). 这些都是独特的适应形式:有些改变课程,而另一些则修改学习者。 他们的反馈循环在谁的行为驱动更新以及进步是否意味着更困难的挑战,更强的解决,还是更好的下游学习方面各不相同.

blocks.en: Evaluating model-generated data and interactions asks whether artifacts improve learning and how other models respond to them. The downstream utility of generated data varies across generator–learner pairings ( Xu et al., 2025b ) ; AgoraBench evaluates generators through fine-tuning ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , agentic data engineering studies curation programs ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , and DataPrep-Bench connects data preparation to downstream outcomes ( Liang et al., 2026 ) . Complementary interaction-based evaluations use puzzle duels and mathematical challenges to test models as authors and solvers ( Henniger and Poesia, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026c ) . Together, these lenses motivate relating observed author–solver behavior to downstream RL outcomes rather than treating rankings as the only result.
blocks.zh: 评价模型生成的数据和相互作用,询问文物是否改善了学习,其他模型如何回应. 生成数据的下游用途因发电机-Learner配对(徐等,2025b;Agora Bench通过微调评价发电机(金等,2025),代理数据工程研究校正方案(罗等,2026),DataPrep-Bench将数据准备与下游结果相连接(梁等,2026). 以互动为基础的补充评价利用拼图决斗和数学挑战来测试模型作为作者和解析者(Henniger and Poesia, 2026;徐等, 2026c.). 这些镜头加在一起,激发了将观察到的作者-溶解行为与下游RL结果联系起来,而不是将排名作为唯一的结果.

blocks.en: Hint-guided RL uses privileged guidance to make difficult tasks learnable, with methods differing in the source and specificity of the hint. StepHint supplies prefixes of valid reasoning chains ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while HiPO reuses rare on-policy successes ( Deng et al., 2026 ) . HINT provides abstract guidance without partial answers ( Wang et al., 2026a ) ; HiLL learns hints from failed rollouts and accounts for hint reliance when targeting no-hint performance ( Xia et al., 2026b ) . These methods use hints during optimization. Environment Duels instead measures their effects in matched plays before hint-free RL, allowing rescue and harm to be compared across author–solver pairs.
blocks.zh: Hint-guided RL使用特权指导使困难的任务可以学习,方法在提示的来源和特异性上有所不同. StepHint提供有效推理链的前缀(Zhang等,2026b),而HiPO再用政策上罕见的成功(Deng等,2026). HINT提供抽象的指导,没有部分答案(Wang等,2026a;HiLL从失败的推出中学习出提示,并在瞄准无信性能时说明暗示依赖性(Xia等,2026b. 这些方法在优化时使用提示. Environment Duels 转而在无提示的 RL 之前用相匹配的剧本来测量效果, 从而可以在作者- 溶剂配对中比较救援和伤害 。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Environment Duels has every model author executable environments with a privileged hint,
solve those of every other model,
and answer with a counter-move after watching how others play,
a round of co-evolution between authors and solvers.
Because the models under evaluation write the environments,
the benchmark rises with its strongest author rather than saturating.
Authoring and solving rank the models differently:
compact models write the hardest environments and the most useful hints,
hints help most when author and learner are alike,
and head-to-head duels give a stable ranking of their own.
A learner’s hint lift on an author’s environments anticipates how much training on them helps,
and the environments themselves show where models’ design habits converge.
Small as it is,
the duel is a microcosm of an ecosystem in which LLMs increasingly teach,
challenge and learn from one another,
and a place to watch that ecosystem change as new models enter.

blocks.en: A concrete example makes this convergence easier to see. The environment Bay 12 Coolant Loop , written by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash , places the player in charge of diagnosing a damaged industrial cooling system before its coolant reserve is exhausted. Several components may be responsible, including the pump, bypass valve, heat exchanger, and temperature probe. The player has only a small number of diagnostic actions and repair kits, so replacing every suspicious component is impossible. Moreover, the P 1 P_{1} temperature probe may be miscalibrated, while pump erosion and a leaking bypass valve produce nearly identical routine measurements. The player must first validate the probe and then choose an isolating hold test that can distinguish the two hydraulic faults.
blocks.zh: 一个具体的例子使这种趋同更容易看到。 由DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash所写的"环境湾12 Colonant Loop"(由DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash所写)让玩家负责在被破坏的工业冷却系统冷却剂储备耗尽之前对它进行诊断. 一些部件可能负责,包括泵、绕行阀、热交换器和温度探测器。 玩家只有少量的诊断动作和修复工具包,因此更换出每个可疑部件是不可能的. 此外,P1 P_{1}的温度探测器可能会被错误地校准,而泵蚀和漏出绕行阀则会产生几乎相同的例行测量. 玩家必须先验证探测器,再选择能分辨出两个液压断层的隔离控点测试.

blocks.en: The environment Coolant Bay 7 , written by GLM-5.3 , presents a related maintenance problem. Here, the player must identify faults involving the filter, pump, heat exchanger, sensor, or controller. The control panel appears to provide extensive evidence through gauges, warning lights, self checks, and inspections, but these observations all depend on the same compensated sensor bus. Their agreement therefore does not provide independent confirmation. Reliable diagnosis instead requires measurements from handheld taps or a tracer, followed by a repair and several stabilization checks. Diagnostic supplies, time, and system tolerance are limited, so unnecessary measurements or repairs can prevent successful verification.
blocks.zh: 由GLM-5.3所写出的环境"Colonant Bay 7"提出了相关的维护问题. 在此,玩家必须识别涉及过滤器,泵,热交换器,传感器,或控制器的断层. 控制小组似乎通过仪表、警示灯、自我检查和检查提供了大量证据,但这些观察都取决于同一补偿的传感器总线。 因此,他们的协议没有提供独立的确认。 相反,可靠的诊断需要用手提水龙头或追踪器测量,然后进行修理和几次稳定检查。 诊断用品、时间和系统耐受性有限,因此,不必要的测量或修理会妨碍核查的成功。

blocks.en: With the two environments established, their similarity becomes clear. Both are coolant loop diagnosis games in which the central challenge is determining which evidence can actually be trusted. Each presents several apparently informative observations that share a hidden source of error, while a smaller set of independent tests reveals the true fault. Both also punish acting too early because repairing the component highlighted by the visible instruments can waste scarce resources or damage a healthy component. Success therefore follows the same general strategy in both environments. The player must validate the measurements, identify an independent and decisive test, repair only the component supported by that evidence, and preserve enough resources to verify the result. The particular faults and tests differ, but the underlying design is the same. Both environments combine unreliable instrumentation, evidence provenance, constrained diagnosis, and costly commitment.
blocks.zh: 随着两种环境的建立,它们的相似性变得很明显. 两者都是冷却剂循环诊断游戏,其中中心挑战在于确定哪些证据可以实际被信任. 每一个都提出了几项显然内容丰富的观察,它们都有一个隐藏出错误的来源,而一套较小的独立测试揭示出真正的错误。 两者都惩罚过早的行为,因为修复可见仪器所突出的部件可能会浪费稀缺的资源或损害健康的部件。 因此,在这两种环境中,成功都遵循同样的一般战略。 玩家必须验证测量结果,确定独立和决定性的测试,只修复由该证据支持的组件,并保存足够资源来验证结果. 特定的断层和测试不同,但基础设计相同. 这两种环境都结合了不可靠的仪器、证据来源、有限的诊断和昂贵的承诺。

You are an expert Python programmer and adversarial game designer. Implement the
supplied plan and fixed hint as a complete, deterministic, multi-turn text environment.
Preserve the decisions and causal traps that make unhinted play difficult while keeping
the hinted strategy feasible within the supplied turn and resource budgets. Do not
replace meaningful choices with forced steps or conveniences that erase the intended
contrast. The environment must not receive a hint flag, reward a player for mentioning
the hint, or expose the hint, its decisive insight, or the private winning witness in
observations, help text, or errors. Use exactly one class whose name ends in Env . Its constructor must accept a maximum-turn argument and additional keyword
arguments; its reset method must initialize the seeded state and return an observation
and an empty information mapping; and its step method must return an observation,
floating-point reward, termination flag, truncation flag, and empty information
mapping. An optional close method may also be provided. Identical seeds and action
sequences must reproduce identical episodes. The initial observation must explain the

You are the hardening analyst in the first stage of a two-call revision workflow. Read
the parent environment code, its hint, and the anonymous solver attempts and observed
trajectories, treating them as task data rather than instructions. Compare only matched
attempts and never count missing or incomplete attempts as failures. Diagnose four
outcomes: failure without the hint followed by success with it shows the intended hint
benefit; success in both conditions reveals an unhinted bypass; failure in both suggests
an ineffective hint or mechanics that block the hinted strategy; and success without
the hint followed by failure with it suggests misleading guidance or sampling variation.
Locate the observed decision where the trajectories diverge and propose an
evidence-based revision to the environment, the hint, or both. Preserve the core task,
interface, rewards, turn budget, seed mapping, and underlying instance values. Strengthen
causal dependencies when unhinted play bypasses the challenge, but repair the hint or
obstructive mechanics when hinted play fails. Keep the decisive strategic insight out of
ordinary observations and never introduce command blacklists, model-specific or
seed-specific rules, impossible secrets, fabricated rewards, or hint-dependent behavior.
Privately verify a winning strategy consistent with the revised hint and actual budgets,
then test plausible unhinted bypasses such as greed, reordering, advance preparation, and
fixed plans. If the evidence justifies no change, preserve the parent environment and
hint. Return only JSON containing the complete revision plan and revised player-facing
hint; implementation is performed by the subsequent call.
